nodes.description: Owner address gating changeOwner and updateContracts in the main Ecocelium contract.
Accounting of ECO earnings already withdrawn per user; incremented/decremented by redeem/adjustEcoEarning.
Whitelist mapping controlling every privileged inter-contract call.
Per-user lock flag set when monthly dues are missed.
Accumulated protocol fees per token symbol.
Storage of matched orders including time, expiryDate, amount and duesPaid.
Status enum per order id (OPENCREATOR, OPENBORROW, MATCHED, CLOSED).
Storage of pending (open) orders keyed by order id.
Wrapped-token balances manipulated by _transfer, _mint, _burn.
Locked (collateralised) token amounts per account.
Initializer registering the first friendly address and owner.
Whitelists an address; the owner check is written as a non-reverting expression statement.
Changes the owner of the init/config contract after an owner check.
Sets the isUserLocked flag for a borrower; privileged via friendlyaddress.
Accumulates protocol fees for a token symbol.
Updates swap, trade and reward fee percentages.
Handles ETH/ERC20 deposits, pulling tokens with transferFrom for ERC20 tokens.
Sends ETH via userAddress.transfer or ERC20 via transfer to the user.
Credits ecoWithdrawls and pays out ECO earnings to a user.
Reduces ecoWithdrawls by an amount without a lower-bound check.
Burns one wrapped token and mints another, recording WGains/WLoss.
External privileged wrapper around wERC20.mint.
External privileged wrapper around wERC20.burnFrom.
External privileged wrapper around wERC20.release.
External privileged wrapper around wERC20.lock.
Mints wrapped tokens; guarded by hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()).
Burns tokens of another account; guarded by MINTER_ROLE.
Grants admin/minter/pauser roles to a new admin; guarded by ETMOWNER_ROLE.
Locks user tokens as collateral; guarded by MINTER_ROLE.
Releases locked tokens; guarded by MINTER_ROLE.
Pauses all transfers; guarded by PAUSER_ROLE.
Unpauses transfers; guarded by PAUSER_ROLE.
Moves balances after comparing amount against availableAmount(sender).
Increases total supply and recipient balance.
Decreases balance and total supply after availableAmount check.
Sets allowances after availableAmount check on the owner.
Transfers and then reduces the spender allowance.
Returns balanceOf(owner) - lockedAmount[owner] using SafeMath.
Performs a low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient.
Performs a low-level call with value and bubbles up revert data.
Initializer wiring owner, EMM, abacus, EDM and Init addresses.
Changes the Ecocelium owner; requires msg.sender == owner.
Re-points EMM, abacus and EDM from Init storage; owner only.
Deposit entry point that mints and locks wrapped tokens and pushes free storage.
Deposits then immediately opens a creator order.
Creates an order from existing deposits and settles ECO earnings.
Opens a borrow order after a withdraw-eligibility check.
Repays a borrow by popping borrow storage and depositing the amount.
Borrows against deposits after eligibility check, then withdraws.
Cross-token swap using oracle price; pops deposit storage and mints output token.
Reads the creator of an order and delegates cancellation to the data manager.
Withdraw entry point; validates lock/eligibility and ECO aggregation using msg.sender.
Internal withdraw: releases, burns, takes fee and pays out via WithdrawManager.
Compares buy power against the USD value of the requested amount.
Pushes a free deposit/borrow record for a user, timestamped with now.
Pops free storage entries in a descending loop, accruing ECO earnings.
Creates an open order and inserts it into the sorted pool.
Sorts the per-token order pool using an uninitialised memory array.
Matches a taker with an open order, sets expiry, schedules checks and moves wrapped tokens.
Order matching engine loop that pushes and matches orders against the pool index.
Releases and burns wrapped tokens for an expired matched order.
Pays a monthly due and updates the user lock status based on elapsed time.
Scheduled due check that mints/locks ECO for the supplier and may expire the order.
Schedules a recurring dueCheck through the Abacus oracle.
Schedules orderExpired at the order expiry time through the Abacus oracle.
Cancels an open order, refunds wrapped tokens and cleans bookkeeping.
Converts a token amount to USD value using oracle price and token decimals.
Computes the monthly due for a matched order using yield, duration and oracle price.
Reads the token price from the Abacus oracle job response.
Computes ECO reward from USD value, slab rate and elapsed time.
Allows friendly addresses to overwrite a pool index entry.
Aggregates ECO earnings across deposits and borrows and nets ecoWithdrawls.
Computes trade fee, net amount and derives the order id from keccak256 of user, token, duration and now.
Increases lockedAmount after an availableAmount check.
Decreases lockedAmount after checking it does not exceed the locked value.
Caller-controlled address used for auth checks and fund routing across all contracts.
Block time (now) used for storage timestamps, expiry, dues and reward math.
Transaction origin; not used for authorization in this codebase (noted for completeness).
External call forwarding value to a recipient, transferring execution control.
Low-level call with arbitrary calldata to a target contract.
Native ETH payout to a user-supplied payable address.
Paid external call to the Abacus oracle scheduling future callbacks into this contract.
Owner check written as a bare expression instead of require, so it never reverts.
Descending loop index and amountLeft arithmetic without SafeMath or bounds checks.
Reward formula depends on (now - time) and oracle price with no sanity bounds.
Balance and total-supply arithmetic relying on availableAmount and SafeMath wrappers.
User-supplied deposit amount for the Deposit entry point.
Amount to pop from free deposit/borrow storage.
Amount of ETH/ERC20 to transfer out to the user.
Remaining amount in the order matching loop.
USD valuation computed from oracle price for the pushed record.
Uninitialised memory array used as scratch buffer while rewriting the order pool.
Order identifier derived from keccak256 over user, token, duration and block time.

edges.reason: wERC20.mint authorizes hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()) before minting.
burnFrom checks MINTER_ROLE against the caller.
changeAdmin requires ETMOWNER_ROLE from the caller.
lock requires MINTER_ROLE from the caller.
release requires MINTER_ROLE from the caller.
pause requires PAUSER_ROLE from the caller.
unpause requires PAUSER_ROLE from the caller.
setFriendlyAddress compares msg.sender with owner but never reverts on failure.
Any caller reaches the whitelist write because the owner check is a no-op expression.
setFriendlyAddress executes the broken comparison statement.
setFriendlyAddress writes friendlyaddress[Address] = true.
setFriendlyAddress reads the owner state variable for the failed comparison.
All withdraw routing is authorized only by friendlyaddress[msg.sender].
Withdraw treats msg.sender as the owner of the funds and lock state.
changeOwner requires msg.sender == owner.
updateContracts requires msg.sender == owner.
EcoceliumInit.changeOwner requires msg.sender == owner.
setUserLocked is gated by friendlyaddress[msg.sender].
setOwnerFeeVault is gated by friendlyaddress[msg.sender].
updateFees is gated by friendlyaddress[msg.sender].
payDue receives msgSender and toggles that user's lock state.
dueCheck acts on the borrower address supplied by the caller.
cancelOrder verifies friendlyaddress[msg.sender] before refunding.
SwapWrapToWrap uses msg.sender as the token holder for the swap.
freePusher stores time: now into the free storage record.
matchOrder sets time and expiryDate using now.
orderExpired requires matchOrderMap[_orderId].expiryDate <= now.
payDue compares duesPaid with (now - time)/30 days to set the lock flag.
dueCheck requires now >= time + duesPaid*30 days.
calculateECOEarning multiplies by (now - time) for the reward.
_ordersub derives the order id from keccak256(..., now).
scheduleExpiry computes the delay as expiryDate - time.
scheduleCheck schedules the next check 30 days out relative to block time.
Deposit calls _deposit to perform the token pull.
Deposit pushes the free storage record via freePusher.
Deposit mints wrapped tokens for the depositor.
Deposit locks the freshly minted wrapped tokens.
depositAndOrder delegates the deposit to _deposit.
depositAndOrder mints wrapped tokens.
depositAndOrder locks wrapped tokens.
depositAndOrder opens a creator order through newOrder.
createOrder pops free storage to realise ECO earnings.
createOrder registers the new order through newOrder.
createOrder pays accrued ECO earnings via WithdrawManager.
createOrder reads and adjusts ecoWithdrawls before paying earnings.
borrowOrder creates a borrow order through newOrder.
borrowOrder requires isWithdrawEligible for the borrower.
clearBorrow pops borrow storage to compute dues.
clearBorrow deposits dues and repayment through DepositManager.
Borrow pushes a borrow record after eligibility check.
Borrow withdraws the borrowed amount to the caller.
SwapWrapToWrap pops deposit storage for the input token.
SwapWrapToWrap performs the wrapped-to-wrapped swap.
cancelOrder reads the creator then calls the data manager cancelOrder.
Withdraw delegates the actual payout to _withdraw.
Withdraw pops free storage when the balance is insufficient.
Withdraw routes payouts through WithdrawManager.
Withdraw validates aggregate ECO balance via getECOEarnings.
Withdraw requires !isUserLocked(msgSender) before allowing funds to leave.
_withdraw pays the user through WithdrawManager.
_withdraw releases the locked wrapped tokens.
_withdraw burns the wrapped tokens being redeemed.
_withdraw pops free storage to settle ECO earnings.
_withdraw adjusts ecoWithdrawls when paying earnings.
isWithdrawEligible values the withdrawal through USDValue.
freePusher computes the USD value of the pushed amount.
freePusher values the record used later for ECO earnings.
freePopper accrues dues via calculateECOEarning.
freePopper prices each popped entry through USDValue.
freePopper iterates and subtracts amountLeft without SafeMath or loop bounds.
pushOrder derives order id, net amount and fee via _ordersub.
pushOrder inserts the order into the sorted pool.
pushOrder writes the openOrderMap entry for the new order.
matchOrder removes the order from the pool via poolSorter.
matchOrder schedules the expiry callback.
matchOrder schedules the first due check.
matchOrder moves the matched amount to the borrower.
matchOrder writes the matchedOrder struct with time and expiryDate.
matchOrder sets orderStatus[_orderId] = MATCHED.
matchOrder deletes the corresponding open order.
newOrder pushes the remainder as a new open order.
newOrder matches against an existing opposite order.
orderExpired releases locked wrapped tokens to the supplier.
orderExpired burns the supplier's wrapped tokens.
orderExpired pays the underlying token back to the supplier.
orderExpired reads expiryDate and amount from matchOrderMap.
payDue computes the due through orderMonthlyDue.
payDue sets the borrower lock flag via the init contract.
payDue increments matchOrderMap[_orderId].duesPaid.
dueCheck computes the monthly due amount.
dueCheck mints ECO to the supplier.
dueCheck expires the order when dues are unpaid.
dueCheck reschedules itself for the next month.
dueCheck reads matchOrderMap time and duesPaid for the schedule condition.
scheduleExpiry pays the oracle to invoke orderExpired in the future.
scheduleCheck pays the oracle to invoke dueCheck in the future.
cancelOrder releases the creator's locked wrapped tokens.
cancelOrder burns the creator's wrapped tokens.
cancelOrder refunds the underlying token to the creator.
cancelOrder removes the order from the pool.
cancelOrder deletes the openOrderMap entry.
orderMonthlyDue values the order amount through USDValue.
orderMonthlyDue uses the ECO token oracle price.
orderMonthlyDue reads matchOrderMap amount, yield, wtoken and status.
calculateECOEarning prices the ECO token via fetchTokenPrice.
calculateECOEarning multiplies by (now - time) with no bounds or SafeMath.
getECOEarnings aggregates calculateECOEarning over deposits and borrows.
getECOEarnings nets the accrued amount against ecoWithdrawls.
redeemEcoEarning increments ecoWithdrawls[userAddress].
adjustEcoEarning subtracts from ecoWithdrawls without a lower bound.
DepositManager pulls ERC20 balances into the contract via transferFrom.
w2wswap releases the input wrapped token.
w2wswap burns the input wrapped token.
w2wswap mints the output wrapped token.
w2wswap locks the output wrapped token.
wERC20.mint delegates to ERC20._mint.
wERC20.burnFrom delegates to ERC20._burn.
wERC20.lock delegates to ERC20._lock.
wERC20.release delegates to ERC20._release.
_transfer compares the amount against availableAmount(sender).
_transfer mutates sender and recipient balances after the available check.
_transfer decrements and increments _balances entries.
_mint adds to the recipient balance and total supply.
_burn subtracts from the account balance and total supply.
_approve validates the amount against availableAmount(owner).
transferFrom performs the balance move through _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
availableAmount subtracts lockedAmount[owner] from the balance.
_lock increments lockedAmount[owner].
_lock checks the amount against availableAmount(owner).
_release decrements lockedAmount[owner].
_release references the same locked accounting used by availableAmount.
sendValue forwards value with a low-level call, handing control to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue executes arbitrary calldata on a target contract.
WithdrawManager transfers native ETH to a user-controlled payable address.
setUserLocked is authorized through the friendlyaddress mapping.
setOwnerFeeVault is authorized through the friendlyaddress mapping.
setOwnerFeeVault accumulates ownerFeeVault[add] += value.
setUserLocked writes isUserLocked[userAddress].
Ecocelium.initialize assigns the owner address once via the initializer.
updatePoolIndex only checks friendlyaddress[msg.sender] before overwriting a pool index.

normalization_plan.reason: Deposit._amount is the user-supplied amount consumed directly by Ecocelium.Deposit.
freePopper._amount is the parameter driving the pop loop in EcoceliumDataManager.freePopper.
WithdrawManager.amount is the payout parameter passed straight into the ETH/ERC20 transfer.
amountLeft is a loop-local accounting variable owned by EcoceliumDataManager.newOrder.
_usdValue is a computed local stored into the free storage record inside freePusher.
temp is the scratch memory array used by poolSorter to rewrite the order pool.
_orderId is the derived identifier returned by _ordersub to pushOrder.
